scope.production_network: Every Rust production TCP/UDP allocation, availability probe, bind, provider bind request, pre-bound listener consumer, and inherited socket found by the recorded scans.
scope.local_ipc: Production Unix-domain binds and inherited descriptors are classified separately because a host TCP/UDP PortLease must not absorb filesystem-path ownership.
scope.tests: Inline and path-owned test fixtures are exemptions only when their cfg/module ownership is mechanically proven below.
scope.identity: Every active occurrence is keyed by repository path, authority kind, enclosing symbol, and ordinal; numeric addresses and ports are diagnostics, never identity.

scan_commands: rg -n 'PublishedEndpointProtocol|PublishedEndpoint' crates/nimbus-network crates/nimbus-sandbox crates/nimbus-services crates/nimbus-tenant crates/nimbus-system crates/nimbus-machine crates/nimbus-node crates/nimbus-server crates/nimbus-cli

production_sites.current_truth: Owns the single crash-safe host-global reserve operation; callers supply stable identity, generation, conflict semantics, and tenant attribution while provider effects remain outside the crate.
production_sites.target_owner: nimbus-network remains the sole allocation authority

production_sites.current_truth: Builds the complete launch request batch and delegates atomic exact/range reservation and tenant accounting to LocalPortLeaseAuthority; it performs no manifest scan or first-free selection.
production_sites.target_owner: nimbus-network owns allocation authority; sandbox owns launch projection and provider sequencing

production_sites.current_truth: Adds the host-internal PEP request to the same atomic launch batch; LocalPortLeaseAuthority selects and fences the port without charging tenant publication quota.
production_sites.target_owner: nimbus-network owns the host-global reservation; sandbox owns PEP desired-state projection

production_sites.current_truth: Projects one already-reserved internal listener into PEP assignment state; later sandbox sequencing claims before the proxy-owned bind and activates only from exact provider evidence.
production_sites.target_owner: sandbox composes the network lease with the proxy-owned PEP effect

production_sites.current_owner: nimbus-cli dev composition consuming nimbus-server listener authority
production_sites.current_truth: Claims before each conventional or provider-assigned real bind, records exact no-effect failure, and retains the socket plus Active lease for server adoption.
production_sites.target_owner: CLI retains the pre-serve socket effect; nimbus-server owns the lease/socket adapter and eventual adoption

production_sites.current_owner: nimbus-cli startup composition plus nimbus-server adoption

production_sites.current_truth: Start adapter resolution is pure desired-state selection; conventional and explicit conflicts are decided by the shared lease plus the real provider bind.
production_sites.target_owner: server shared authority plus real provider bind

production_sites.current_owner: nimbus-cli machine adapter consuming nimbus-network authority
production_sites.current_truth: Atomically range-reserves and claims a loopback port in the shared node-local authority before gvproxy can start.

production_sites.current_truth: Production machine allocation performs no socket probe/drop; only explicit test harnesses create real external-binder evidence.
production_sites.target_owner: network lease plus gvproxy provider-bind evidence

production_sites.current_owner: nimbus-cli socket effect consuming nimbus-server listener authority
production_sites.current_truth: Resolves candidate addresses, reserves and claims before each real bind, records exact no-effect failure, and adopts/activates the observed address before publication.
production_sites.target_owner: CLI retains hostname resolution and the socket effect; nimbus-server owns the listener lease adapter

production_sites.current_truth: Validates LISTEN_PID/LISTEN_FDS, consumes inherited TCP fd 3, converts it to Tokio, and adopts it with externally owned provenance so Nimbus never releases systemd authority.

production_sites.current_truth: Declares the main TCP ListenStream for systemd to bind before process start; Nimbus later adopts the inherited descriptor.
production_sites.target_owner: systemd retains the bind effect; Nimbus records external provenance

production_sites.current_truth: Consumes same-incarnation pre-bound siblings when supplied; otherwise claims before each MongoDB, DynamoDB, or S3 bind, guards while claimed, adopts/activates, then serves unchanged protocol bytes.
production_sites.target_owner: server retains binds and protocol tasks; every listener consumes a nimbus-network lease

production_sites.current_truth: Converts a continuously held standard listener to Tokio without releasing its Active lease; public embedders explicitly adopt external sockets and same-incarnation checks fence every handoff.

production_sites.current_owner: nimbus-kv socket adapter consuming nimbus-network authority
production_sites.current_truth: Claims before the standalone RESP bind, records durable no-effect failure, and adopts/activates the exact observed address before serving.
production_sites.target_owner: KV retains RESP and socket effects while consuming the cross-process lease authority

production_sites.current_truth: Adopts an injected Tokio listener with externally owned provenance, validates its exact address, and never releases the external socket authority as Nimbus-owned.

production_sites.current_owner: nimbus-proxy socket, policy-enforcement, and forwarding effect
production_sites.current_truth: Binds and retains an inert PEP listener only after sandbox owns the exact durable bind claim; sandbox adopts/activates before PreparedWorkloadPep starts its accept loop.

production_sites.current_truth: Validates the exact request, binds and retains an inert wildcard guest listener under its durable claim, then adopts/activates the complete batch before any accept loop starts.

production_sites.current_truth: Lowers only the lease-authenticated sandbox bindings into the Netavark request; Netavark owns the kernel effects and sandbox records exact provider evidence.

production_sites.current_truth: Serializes exact expose requests only after lease-authenticated inert guest listeners exist, and accepts withdrawal only from a typed generation-matching receipt or authenticated exact absence; the external forwarder owns the host publication effect.
production_sites.target_owner: sandbox retains provider effects and exact inspection/delete evidence

production_sites.current_truth: Passes only the shared authority's durably range-selected and claimed port to gvproxy; exact SSH readiness adopts and activates the provider result.
production_sites.target_owner: machine retains gvproxy effect; provider observation completes the nimbus-network lease

The sandbox adapter persists provider-adjacent state while implementing the injected portable allocation contract.

trust_inputs_not_network_authorities.network_rule: Compute may compile only already trusted and admitted tenant attribution; request path data never selects a network tenant.
Network never selects a verifier or inspects a bearer; failed authentication or admission makes zero network calls.
An in-memory generation lifetime for staged artifacts is not a PortLease and remains a distinct authority.

The exact child path is admitted only while its declaration remains inside the mechanically verified #[cfg(test)] tests module and no production mod, path, or include edge reaches it.
Loopback ephemeral fixture; the structural scanner rejects any production inclusion edge into the benchmark path.
